repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ ## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `ddb6f6fbaab645200d0587125792f85db0406f4d` · 2026-11-25T08:54Z - **Shape.** The PR is a draft against `main`, its first line is `Fixes #37239`, and a full close is right because the card is the nightly red and this PR is its whole fix. It changes 4 files, +176/−6: the hook, two pin files and one changeset. Nothing touches `content/docs/releases/`, `CHANGELOG.md` or `packages/spec`. The card is open, `priority:p1` and `pm:dispatched`. The zone report is comment 7156592524 on #37239 (2026-11-25T08:05:21Z). - **Cause, checked on git.** In the window between the last green nightly `d9c799c10` and the red one `0a1b69c0b`, three commits touch `components/src/custom/`, `data-table.tsx`, `ui/table.tsx` or the spec: - #36978 (`c48f06c87`) is the only one that edits `declared-sharing-rules-reach-13091.spec.ts`. It moved the list onto ObjectGrid/`data-table` and pointed the spec at `data-table-scroll-shadow-right`. That makes it the exposer. - #37124 (`517e4153c`) changes the footer row only. - #37049 (`9c5fb3efd`) changes `sort-builder.tsx` only. - #37089 (`886e97073`) does edit `ResourceListPage.tsx`, but only behind `type === 'permission'` (the "New similar" row action and dialog). The sharing-rule list at `/studio/~all/metadata/sharing_rule` never reaches that branch. "Ruled out" holds. - **Root cause, not a mask.** At head, `data-table.tsx` renders `scroll box > `. The shadcn `Table` is `
`. So the `
` is the box's grandchild, and before this PR it was never an observer target. - The other two effects in `data-table` (`scrollsSideways` and the `rightShadow` measure) already observe `tableRef`. That is why the bar showed while the shadow did not, which matches the PR's DOM log. - The fix changes no read. It only adds observer targets, so the shadow now follows the element whose width actually drives `scrollWidth`. - **Cost and loops.** The added targets are each direct child's children, all on the one existing `ResizeObserver`. That is 2 targets for `data-table` (wrapper and table) and 2 for the approvals inbox (wrapper and table). The grouped grid has `min-w-max div` plus a few `data-table` shell nodes. Rows sit at depth ≥3 (`table > tbody > tr`), so the count does not grow with table size. - `read` sets a boolean, and React skips the update when the value is unchanged. - Both shadows render as siblings outside the observed box (`data-table-scroll-shadow-right`; `horizontal-overflow-shadow` in `HorizontalOverflowBox`). `data-overflow-right` toggles only `before:` opacity. No observed node changes size because of a read, so there is no `ResizeObserver` loop. - **Pins re-run at head (seat, throwaway worktree).** Command: `vitest run data-table-scroll-shadow-12463.test.tsx horizontal-overflow-12708.test.tsx`. Result: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 15 passed (15)`. - **Ablation (seat).** I deleted the single `for (const grandchild …) observer.observe(grandchild);` line and re-ran. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 13 passed (15)`. - The `HorizontalOverflowBox` pin fails with `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="horizontal-overflow-shadow"]`. - The `data-table` pin fails with `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="data-table-scroll-shadow-right"]`. - Both CONTROLs stay green. Restoring the line gives a clean `git diff`. This matches the PR's ablation reading. - **Pin quality.** The recording `ResizeObserver` calls back only the observers registered on the element that resized, so these pins test which elements are targets. The `data-table` pin also checks the DOM shape (`table.parentElement !== box`, grandparent `=== box`), so a later refactor that removes the wrapper cannot leave it green for the wrong reason. - **Live evidence: the dev's reading, not re-run by the seat.** - Before the fix: 5/10 repeats red with the nightly's error. - After the fix: 20/20, and `test:e2e:live:nightly` 28/28. - The raw logs were lost mid-session (this is declared as a deviation). The PR quotes them verbatim, with commands. - CI `Live E2E UI` is `success` at head. - **Other consumers.** - `useHorizontalOverflow` from `custom/` has two callers: `data-table.tsx:3585` and `HorizontalOverflowBox`. - `HorizontalOverflowBox` has two in-tree mounts. The first is `ObjectGrid` grouped (`box > div.min-w-max`, already covered as a direct child). The second is `ApprovalsInboxPage` (`box > Table wrapper > table`, now covered). - `components/src/hooks/use-horizontal-overflow.ts` (used by `containers.tsx`) is a separate hook with the same name. The PR does not touch it. - **CI at head.** There are 58 check-runs, all `completed`: 45 `success`, 13 `skipped` (path-filtered or opt-in), and 0 failure or pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 shards), `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` are all `success`. The whole-package 4,970-test reading is covered by the `Test UI` shards. - **Merge state.** `origin/main` is `9171bed0a65a`. K = 6 (first-parent since merge-base `d7f299c0b1e0`). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` exits 0 with no conflicts. None of the PR's four files, nor `data-table.tsx` or `ui/table.tsx`, changed on main since the merge-base. - **Overlap.** I checked all 40 other open PRs. Only #37215 touches any of these paths: it edits `data-table.tsx`, but not the scroll box or the overflow lines. A pairwise `merge-tree` with #37253 is clean. No open PR touches `use-horizontal-overflow.ts` or either pin file. - **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset. Kind `none` takes `patch`, and the changeset is `'@object-ui/components': patch`. That package has no `private` flag, so it is published and needs a changeset, which it has. There is no `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so `dogfood_battery` n/a is right. - **Changeset, read sentence by sentence.** - (1) The shadow while columns remain to the right: true, it is drawn from `overflowRight`. - (2) "only re-read … when the box itself or the element directly inside it changed size": true for size triggers. See N1. - (3) The wrapper keeps the box's width, and the shadow failed about half the time at 1440 px: matches the `Table` markup and the 5/10 reading. - (4) "now also watches what sits inside that wrapper": true, this is the grandchild loop. - (5) "every page that puts a table in the shared overflow box (for example the approvals inbox)": true for both in-tree mounts. See N2. - **维护者速读, read sentence by sentence.** - "右侧固定列前那道…阴影现在每次都会出现": the spec's header says the seam sits at the pinned cells, and the 20/20 reading backs "every time". - "共享规则列表在 1440 宽下的可达性检查": this matches the spec, which uses `viewport 1440×1000` and `LIST = /studio/~all/metadata/sharing_rule`. - "最坏只是…阴影不显示或多显示一次": true; this is a read-only visual affordance. - "要你做什么:无": true for Tier S, not governed. - N1 — In changeset sentence (2), the box also re-read on every `scroll`. So the shadow stayed hidden "until the user scrolled", not "never". This is cosmetic; a release-time rewording would be enough. - N2 — The grandchild depth is a heuristic. A public `HorizontalOverflowBox` consumer that nests the table three or more levels deep, with full-width wrappers, would still miss the widening. Effect deps are `[ref, disabled]`, so targets are collected once and are not re-collected when the children are swapped. Neither applies to an in-tree consumer today (the `
` in both mounts is static JSX). Both are pre-existing, and this PR does not make either worse. If it ever bites, the more precise design is an explicit content-element option (such as `data-table`'s own `tableRef`). - N3 — #37089 is not literally "not touching this list". It edits `ResourceListPage.tsx`, but only on the permission-type branch, which this list never reaches. The ruling holds; only the PR body's wording is loose. - Landing: the zone lands it after measuring K; if K ≥ 15 it merges main first; a merge-only head move keeps this ACCEPT. No must-fix, no should-fix.

Landing · 2026-11-25T08:54Z · head `ddb6f6fbaa` · zone a4-S (#37239, p1)

- L1 ACCEPT from seat `repo:objectstack#4` at `ddb6f6fbaa`, on this PR (7157620406). No must-fix and no should-fix.
  - The seat re-checked the cause on git: #36978 exposed it, #37089 is ruled out.
  - It re-ran the pins (15/15) and its own ablation (2 red, the CONTROLs green).
  - N1–N3 are cosmetic or pre-existing.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37253`: NOT governed; 182 changed lines, under 3,000.
- Checks on the head: 45 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed (Test UI 16/16, Live E2E UI and Dogfood Regression Gate among them).
- K: GitHub compare puts the head 6 commits behind `main`, under 15. `merge-tree` with `origin/main` is clean.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; `'@object-ui/components': patch`. No L2 is owed: a read-only visual affordance, no contract face.
- Action: ready, then auto-merge through the merge queue, ahead of tonight's nightly (05:29Z), which re-runs the spec on `main`.
